cohort: 1577 women who underwent indicated induction of labor over 24 months at two institutions
finding: Indicated inductions which result in cesarean delivery were more likely in women with higher body mass indexes, lower parity, and Bishops scores, as well as preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more likely in women with indicated inductions of labor who had higher body mass indexes, lower parity, lower Bishops scores, and preeclampsia.
